listings.Job Description: AWS have an exciting internship opportunity for a UAE national with family book. This role is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cutting edge data centers in the world. A Data Center Technician Intern will work as part of the Operations team whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure. This position involves hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair.
listings.Job Requirements: In pursuit of IT Certification or Technical/Bachelors Degree within a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair or similar. UAE National with family book.
